answer: Make voting weight grow like jade under a carver's tool: slowly, through months of graded work that random unrelated peers verify. A new key starts near zero and its influence reaches a capped zenith only after a long, unbroken record. Spinning up a thousand fresh sybils buys a thousand voices worth almost nothing, while the ledger keeps each history crystal clear, so one exposed fake that shares funding or timing with others drags the whole cluster back to zero.
